qrmatch.title: Payment matching
qrmatch.subtitle: Match incoming payments to open invoices.

reason.exact_open_plus_fee: Amount equals invoice plus reminder fee
reason.amount_short: Amount is below the open amount
reason.amount_over: Amount is above the open amount
reason.no_invoice: No open invoice for this reference
reason.ambiguous_reference: Several open invoices claim this reference
reason.reference_invalid: The reference has an invalid check digit

qrmatch.feeShare: Of which reminder fee: {fee} (parked as credit balance).
qrmatch.autoApply: Apply confident matches automatically (exact reference and exact amount only)
qrmatch.empty: No incoming payments to match yet
qrmatch.emptyHint: Record a bank credit to match it against an open invoice.
qrmatch.denied: Requires the permission to book payments
qrmatch.deniedRead: You need sales read access to see the matching queue.
qrmatch.deniedNote: You are missing the permission for that.
qrmatch.periodLocked: The period is locked: the payment cannot be booked there.
qrmatch.currencyMismatch: The currencies differ: record the payment with its conversion under Payments.
qrmatch.needsBankAccount: The bank account is not registered.

error.action: That did not work. Try again.
error.record: The credit could not be recorded.

qrmatch.overrideAudit: Applied by {who} on {when}. A correction reverses the payment and books anew.
qrmatch.lossAboveThreshold: The remainder of {loss} exceeds the write-off ceiling ({threshold}): record the payment with a deliberate write-off under Payments.
qrmatch.creditedShare: Of which offset by credit note: {credited}.

camt.denied: Requires the permission to book payments
camt.duplicate: This statement was already imported; nothing was recorded twice.
camt.seeQueue: Decide it in the queue above

form.allowDuplicates: This really is a second, genuine booking (not a re-delivery)

board.title: Bank statement
board.notReconciled: Not yet reconciled to the account balance
board.emptyHint: Import another statement to see its movements.

dialog.pickEntry: Or: link an existing entry (entry ID)
dialog.noAccountMatch: No account matches what you typed.

preview.title: Posting preview
preview.unavailable: The posting preview is not available here: this movement's bank account is not linked to a ledger account. Booking itself still works.
preview.bankUnlinked: Bank account without a ledger account

werkbank.title: Split the movement
werkbank.restOpen: Allocate the whole amount before booking: {amount} is still open.
werkbank.over: The allocation exceeds the movement by {amount}.

error.schemaInvalid: The file could not be read: check that it is a valid camt.053/054 XML file.
error.ibanMismatch: The IBAN in the file does not match the chosen bank account.
error.currencyMismatch: The currency differs from the base currency: book this under Payments or as a manual entry.
error.statementAmended: This statement was already imported, but the new file differs: {changes}. The existing entries were NOT overwritten.
error.wrongDirection: This entry is a credit (money coming in) and cannot be booked as an outgoing payment. For a returned payment, reverse it under Payments.

camt.needsBankAccount: The bank account is not registered.
camt.skipped: {count} entries were not imported (already present or unreadable).
camt.needsReview: Needs review: no suggestion reached the review threshold

suggestion.batchMismatch: The batch total does not match this transaction: use the manual split below
suggestion.none: No counterpart found: book the line as an expense or split it.

statements.title: Bank statements
statements.emptyHint: Import a camt.053 file from your bank. Its lines then show up here, and you see what is still open.

Reconciliation.title: Payment matching
Reconciliation.body:
Incoming payments meet their invoices here. On top sits the queue of QR credits with suggestions to accept, review or correct; every decision is made on the row it concerns.

When you import a bank statement, its own list to allocate and post appears below.

Credits are always decided in the queue above, so the same decision has only one place.
